summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Neuberger Japan Equity ETF (NBJP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, primarily investing in equity securities of companies economically tied to Japan across all capitalizations and sectors. The fund targets firms it deems to be high-quality, with significant growth potential, aiming for long-term capital appreciation NBJP was launched on Sep 11, 2024 and is issued by Neuberger Berman.

holdings.infoBox: NBJP is an equity ETF with a total of 56 individual holdings. The top holdings are Resona Holdings stock at 4.94%, Mizuho Financial Group at 4.67%, Tokio Marine Holdings at 4.66%, Sysmex at 4.13%, and Hochiki at 3.94%.
